rules.statement: A guardian ad litem appointed for minors in a partition suit does not need to obtain a certificate of curatorship under section 582 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "But the converse proposition, that a next friend or guardian ad litem must be appointed curator does not hold good. The provision contained in section 582 is to the effect that a person cannot defend or institute an action of this description until he has obtained a certificate of curatorship, where the action is connected with the estate of a minor of which he claims the charge of the estate of the minors, and there is no necessity for his obtaining a certificate of curatorship."
